rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for telling an invented or fantasy story aloud.

example.english: When I was little, I loved hearing Grandma fabulate about fairies living in the moonlight.
example.traditional: 我細個最鍾意聽阿嫲講故仔，講到啲精靈住喺月光入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 teng1 aa3 maa4 gong2 gu2 zai2 gong2 dou3 di1 zing1 ling4 zyu6 hai2 jyut6 gwong1 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the speaker is making up the story, especially as an excuse or fabrication.

example.english: Don't fabulate an excuse; you clearly broke the vase and are blaming the cat.
example.traditional: 你唔好作故仔喇，明明係你整爛個花樽，仲話係隻貓撞跌嘅。
